item.title: Frank J Dunn Pool decommissioning expected to be completed this month
item.description: The Frank J. Dunn Pool in Carlton Comprehensive High School will become a new space in the near future. Crews poured concrete into the pool as part of the decommissioning process on Thursday, sealing off the area, which served Prince Albert swimmers since 1974.
